question_text: Five applicants—Juan, Maria, Pedro, Ana, and Lito—are ranked based on their CSE ratings, interview scores, and years of experience. The following facts are known: (1) Juan has a higher CSE rating than Maria. (2) Pedro has more experience than Ana but less than Lito. (3) Maria has a higher interview score than Juan. (4) The applicant with the highest CSE rating has the least experience. (5) The applicant with the highest interview score has the most experience. If Lito has the highest interview score, which of the following must be true?

options.text: Juan has the highest CSE rating.
Pedro has the lowest CSE rating.
